summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MeetFlow Phase 5 features: Meeting Templates (CRUD + create meeting from template) and Organization Branding (company name, primary color, logo upload via Object Storage, email footer, live preview in admin panel). All backend APIs working perfectly. Frontend integration successful with minor session management observations.

design_issues.issue: Minor session management during extended testing - not affecting core functionality

passed_tests: Templates API: POST /api/templates creates template successfully
Templates API: GET /api/templates returns user templates with correct count
Templates API: POST /api/templates/{id}/create-meeting creates meeting from template
Branding API: GET /api/organization/branding returns branding data
Branding API: PUT /api/organization/branding updates branding (admin only)
Branding API: POST /api/organization/branding/logo uploads logo to Object Storage
Meeting Create Page: Templates button shows template count (1)
Meeting Create Page: Load template dialog shows templates list with use/delete buttons
Meeting Create Page: Save as Template button opens dialog with name input
Sidebar: Shows updated company name from branding context (MeetFlow Test Corp)
Admin Page: Branding tab accessible and functional
Object Storage integration working for logo uploads
BrandingContext provides data to sidebar for white-label functionality
